column1: # Each row breaks something on purpose and names the assertion that must notice.
# Tab separated: file, sed expression, test file, test filter, what it breaks.
# Every mutation here is a bug this repo actually shipped, or the failure mode a
# test was written for. A row that stops failing means the assertion has gone
# blind, which is worse than not having it.
